VULN-001.expert_rationale: Internal wiki has low criticality; data is backed up in VCS. High CVSS score does not translate to immediate business danger.

VULN-002.expert_rationale: Internet-facing via DMZ proxy, processes cardholder data, direct revenue impact, mandatory PCI-DSS 30-day remediation.

VULN-003.expert_rationale: Unreachable in current topology. Firewall rule FW-014 blocks internal traffic to 10.0.1.5; only port 443 is permitted from DMZ.

VULN-004.expert_rationale: Contains unencrypted employee PII subject to GDPR penalties. Reachable within HR subnet and management VLAN.

VULN-005.expert_rationale: Port 445 is not reachable; network policy restricts HR DB access to ports 1433/3389 only from HR subnet and management VLAN.
